Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 28-Jun-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  FOURTH SEMESTER B.TECH. (ELECTRONICS AND COMMUNICATION ENGINEERING) DEGREE EXAMINATIONS -  
  JUNE 2024  
  SUBJECT: ECE 2221/ECE_2221 - VLSI DESIGN  
  VLSI DESIGN [ECE 2221]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                    Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  A  
Answer all the questions.  
Missing data may be suitably assumed.  
  
1A)                For an enhancement-type NMOS transistor with VT = 0.7V, source terminal grounded, and a 1.5V         (4)  
  $$DC applied to the gate, determine the operating region for (a) VD = +0.5V, (b) VD = +0.9V, and (c)$$  
  VD = +3V. Given the device parameters µnCox = 100 µA/V2 , W = 10 µm, and L = 1 µm, calculate  
  the drain current for each case (a), (b), and (c).  
1B)                Determine the region of operation of M1 in each of the circuits shown in Fig. Q1B below. Given that (3)  
  $$VTP=-0.4 V.$$  
  
  
1C)                Determine the Pull-up to Pull-down Ratio for depletion nMOS Inverter driven through one or more      (3)  
  pass transistors (Fig. Q1C)  
  
  
2A)                Draw the schematic circuit from the stick diagram shown Fig. Q2A.                                    (4)  
  
  
  Page 1 of 2

2B)   What is the body effect in MOSFETs, and how does it influence the device operation                   (3)  
2C)   Explain the latchup problem in CMOS circuits and discuss strategies to mitigate it.                  (3)  
3A)   Explain the steps involved in the fabrication of a single CMOS inverter containing trivalent and     (4)  
  pentavalent impurity "wells".  
3B)   Draw the layout and stick diagram of 2:1 MUX using transmission logic.                               (3)  
3C)   Show that Pseudo NMOS inverter is more power efficient than depletion NMOS inverter. Assume          (3)  
  $$VDD = 5V, µn=2.5µp and sheet resistance of NMOS transistor is Rs=10kΩ$$  
4A)   Describe the working of n-bit parity generator using structured approach and draw its stick Diagram. (4)  
4B)   Derive the expression for inverter pair delay of geometrically cascaded CMOS inverter in standard    (3)  
  delay units for the given figure 4B.  
  
  
4C)   Design a D-latch using NOR gate in CMOS design style.                                                (3)  
5A)   Design an ALU using Full adder to perform.                                                           (4)  
  i) A XOR B  
  ii) A -B  
  iii) A and B  
  $$Where A=1101 and B =1001 compute$$  
5B)   Implement the given words using NOR ROM and draw its stick diagram.                                  (3)  
  
  
5C)   Design a XOR gate using domino logic, explain the working operation.                                 (3)
